question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"policies".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Policies' **refer to a set of principles or guidelines that are used to make decisions or achieve certain goals.
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence.
 
• Grammatically, **'policies'** is a plural noun and agrees with the verb &
